opening.argument: The video presents a purported free $1000 Victoria's Secret gift card and directs viewers to obtain it through an external shortened URL. The title expressly promotes a "$1000 Free Victoria's Secret Gift Card," while the description repeats that offer and supplies "http://www.tinyurl.com/1000secretcard." The frame reinforces the same solicitation with the instruction "Sign up now for yours!" alongside the shortened link. Together, the gift-card imagery and explicit signup instruction frame the offer as a low-barrier acquisition requiring viewers to follow the external signup path.
